android.desc:
Chat without compromise.

AnChat Lite is a private messenger built for people who refuse to trade their privacy for convenience. No email. No phone number. Just a wallet — and the app creates it for you in seconds.

TRULY PRIVATE COMMUNICATION
• Post-quantum end-to-end encryption — your messages, groups, calls and video calls are encrypted on your device using a hybrid X25519 + ML-KEM-768 scheme, built to resist even future quantum attacks. Not even we can read them.
• Wallet-based identity — your self-custodial wallet is your login.
• No personal data collection — no email, no phone number, no tracking.

DECENTRALIZED BY DESIGN
Built on the open-source Orama Network, AnChat distributes your data across a global peer-to-peer network. There's no central server to hack, no single point of failure, and no company holding your conversations hostage.

BUILT-IN WALLET
Every account comes with a self-custodial wallet, powered by RootWallet — our
own wallet. Send and receive on Solana, Ethereum, Base, and Bitcoin, all from
inside the app. Your keys are derived on your device and never leave it. AnChat never holds your funds.

FEATURE-RICH MESSAGING
• Direct messages, group chats, and rooms
• Encrypted voice and video calls — incoming calls ring even when your phone
  is locked
• Share photos, videos, documents, and voice messages
• Reactions, replies, mentions, edits, pinned messages and in-chat search
• Link previews and chat backgrounds
• Hide the member list in groups
• Call history
• Block unwanted contacts and calls
• Vanish — delete your account and data completely

STEALTH MODE
One tap turns on five privacy protections:
• Touch Reveal — chats stay blurred until you touch to read
• Invite Only — hide from search; reachable only via a rolling invite code
• Screenshot Block — block screenshots and screen recording of your chats
• Voice Mask — a randomized voice disguise on your voice messages
• Ghost Trail — hide your online status and read receipts

APP LOCK
Lock the app with Face ID, Touch ID, or a 4- or 6-digit PIN. With a PIN you can
also set a duress PIN: if you are ever forced to unlock your phone, enter that
one instead and the app quietly erases your data, showing nothing but a blank
screen. Optional auto-erase after too many failed attempts.

OPEN LINKS THROUGH TOR
Hand any link straight to Tor Browser, so the site never learns your IP address.

quotes.text:
AnChat Lite is an E2E encrypted messenger that runs on decentralized infrastructure
instead of central servers (orama.network). Authentication is wallet-based — no phone number, no email, no identity requirements.

We built it because every "private" messenger still depends on centralized
infrastructure controlled by a single entity. Signal requires a phone number
and routes through Signal's servers. Matrix is federated but still
server-dependent. We wanted something where no single entity controls the
messaging infrastructure.

How it works:

- Messages route through the Orama Network — a distributed network of
  independent nodes, not a single central server
- E2E encryption on all message content
- Metadata shielding via the ANyONe Protocol (onion routing) — not just
  message content, but who talks to whom is hidden
- The infrastructure layer is custom-built: Go backend, Raft-based distributed
  SQL (RQLite), WireGuard mesh between independent nodes, self-operated DNS
- No AWS, no GCP — runs on independent VPS nodes with no cloud provider
  dependency
- Wallet-based auth means zero identity data collected at signup

Currently in closed beta on iOS (TestFlight) and Android (Google Play + APK).

Known limitations: beta quality, small user base, wallet-based onboarding has
friction for non-crypto-native users. Working on all of it.

What we'd love feedback on:
- The decentralized messaging architecture and its tradeoffs vs. federated
  (Matrix) or centralized (Signal)
- UX …
